question: By whose grace has the determination of the Kaula doctrine been understood?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Understanding came by that lord's grace
The Kaula determination is now known
inference: Therefore the speaker has understood the Kaula doctrine through the grace of the lord of Kaulas.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have understood the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
